deadline_note: Restore full workflow contract in Phase 2.5 before any Phase 3 kickoff.
common_guard: stabilization-only + full-flow restoration. no Phase 3 scope expansion. evidence-first, schema-valid artifacts required.
common_rules: Do not expose secrets, API keys, or DB credentials in plain text.
No deploy/schema migration/permission elevation/destructive command without explicit user approval.
All task/result/handoff JSON outputs must pass local contract validation.
No narrative-only completion claim without reproducible evidence paths.
Phase 2.5 must focus on full user workflow restoration, not architecture migration.
